description: Search LinkedIn for fresh people leads from the request user's connected account. Use this when the user describes leads to find by words, roles, companies, or market terms, rather than asking to search existing saved leads. Returns a server-owned session_id and up to 10 lead previews. To import the results, call import_search_leads_to_list with that session_id after the user asks to import all or selected leads. Over MCP: call this tool once, without confirmation_token. It runs right away and returns the result.

query.description: Free-text people search, e.g. 'YC founders building AI devtools'

role.description: Optional job-title filter, e.g. 'Founder OR CEO'

name: search_external_leads
